masters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable painted 2D action-RPG VFX ingredient, family ground-fill. Create ONE neutral grayscale still texture: a face-on circular coin of swirling turbulent magical energy, with a richly filled interior of interlocking soft smoky curls and small sharply painted white-hot veins. All round contours are true circles viewed straight down, never an ellipse. The visual is only surface energy, with no upright flames or floating objects. Readable high-contrast illustrated game effect, soft translucent outer falloff and crisp internal light detail, suitable for tinting into fire, cold, lightning, earth, poison, chaos, and neutral palettes. Canvas exactly 1024 by 1024 RGBA. Center at (512,512); entire visible effect inside the central 800 by 800 pixels, minimum 100 pixels completely transparent padding on every side. Fill the circular interior, no empty central hole. One still image, no atlas, no grid. Single isolated effect ingredient, neutral grayscale, white-hot core and dark smoke falloff, centered, transparent background, no ground plane, no shadow, no border, no text, square composition. No backdrop, checkerboard, landscape, character, cast shadow, lens flare, perspective or baked camera.
